description: Writes Animatron studio compositions from a plain-language brief, validated with the studio's own import and repair code, and returns a JSON file plus a #share= link; on request makes short animatron-share links with preview cards drawn by the studio's own renderer; places and animates Mid-century Ink rigged characters with the studio's rig engine.

interface.defaultPrompt: Create an Animatron composition from my brief.
interface.longDescription: Create Animatron compositions from briefs, place supplied Mid-century Ink rigs, validate imports and share round trips with the studio source, and render preview frames when dependencies are available.

name: animatron-composer
